svg.title: Historic arms: the source evidence
svg.desc: Four unaltered document excerpts: OIC 1121/1978 page 1 government caption, page 4 blackletter map heading, and two different arms drawings from the cover and title page of a 1954 provincial mining pamphlet. These are scans, not the exported vector study. The map creation date, historical master and exact typefaces remain unknown.
